svg.aria-label: Left: one prompt to a frontier model over invoices, a price sheet and contracts; an attention heatmap over the same excerpt is uneven across equally consequential numbers, and the answer is vague. Right: encoded Prolog strategies search the same excerpt with targeted highlights and compute explicitly. The fee-cap rule passes at $146.32 a month over cap; the billable-doors rule v1 never queries the price sheet, returns $0.00 and fails its test, a blindspot fixed in dev. Expanding coverage becomes a scenario-enumeration task that can be independently verified and iteratively optimized.
